Substituting $c = 2p$ and $p = 2r$, we get $2p + p + r = 700$, which simplifies to $3p + r = 700$.
Since $p = 2r$, we have $3(2r) + r = 700$, which means $6r + r = 700$, so $7r = 700$, and $r = 100$.
Then $p = 2r = 2(100) = 200$.
And $c = 2p = 2(200) = 400$.
The number of worker bees is 400.
